_comment: Defect declarations for the showcase replay clip (demos/showcase.json); see demos/README.md, Sidecar declarations.

overlap.reason: uid 7: an archer block standing in the routing uid 2's line of flight and fighting it. Over the ticks both runs share (942-1012) the router's closest body pair to uid 7 is 3.37 wu at the #1739 head against 2.01 wu on the merge-base, so the router comes no nearer; at the head the router lives on to tick 1072 (gone at 1012 on the merge-base), still against uid 7, and over those extra ticks the pair reaches 1.34 wu (tick 1028). Holding the flight feed-forward off the router's contact bodies moved that only to 1.49 wu, so it is melee contact, not the flight drive. Afterwards uid 7 presses against its friendly neighbour uid 8: on a 2-tick scan from the divergence (tick 942), nnd_min 0.905 wu at the #1739 head (worst at tick 1218, uid 8 0.4 wu away) against the 2.25 wu floor, merge-base 8.762. No #1739 code path runs in uid 7's own update. The one way #1739 reaches it is through the router: the router's refreshed enemy-contact flag feeds this unit's own _separate() pair test against the router while the two are in contact. Tracked as a block crowding after a full-pace router leaves in #1757.

misslotted.reason: uid 7, the same block as the overlap entry, after the routing uid 2 leaves it. On a 2-tick scan from the divergence (tick 942): misslotted fraction 0.478 at the #1739 head against 0.25, merge-base 0.130. No #1739 code path runs in uid 7's own update (see the overlap entry); tracked with its overlap in #1757.
